Subject: Coverage request: Senior SWE candidate - Samira Khan

Hi Nikhil / Monica / Lauren,

We have a strong candidate for the Senior Software Engineer (infra) role — Samira Khan — who completed the take-home and screening. The hiring manager is hoping to move to panel interviews next week and asked for a compact panel (3 interviewers + debrief). Can you confirm availability and coverage?

Candidate windows (PST): Mon 3/8 9-12, Tue 3/9 13-17, Wed 3/10 9-12. Ideally we'd like a 90-minute slot for:
- Systems design (45)
- Deep dive / coding (30)
- Behavioral / culture + debrief (15)

Please: 1) confirm who can take which slot, 2) provide one backup interviewer in case of conflicts, and 3) confirm willingness to do a quick 20-min debrief immediately after.

Resume attached: Samira_Khan_Resume.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

Thanks,
Marissa (on behalf of TalentPartner)

- Systems design (45): Lauren Bishop (lauren.bishop@redwood.ai)
- Deep dive / coding (30): Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.ai) — if Marcus is unavailable, Lauren can take a hybrid slot and we’ll slot Marcus as backup.
- Behavioral + debrief (15): Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai) — Monica will own the debrief and collect notes.

Backups: Roster backup is me (Nikhil) and Lauren as second fallback. If Marcus needs to swap last-minute we’ll accept asynchronous feedback via the debrief doc.

Load-balancing note: Marcus has a denser calendar on Tue afternoons; if possible prefer Mon 3/8 9:30–11:00 PST (candidate overlap). If that slot doesn’t work, Tue 3/9 13:30–15:00 PST is acceptable.

I’ve attached a brief with suggested question owners and rubrics — please push to the candidate calendar when confirmed.

Thanks — I’ll wait for candidate confirmation and then publish invites.
